subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the per-source Discord settlement bug is fixed, should yielded cron handoff become a permanent public `deferred` status across persistence, Gateway protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and plugin SDK?
rationale: The observable bug can be repaired with internal lifecycle/task state; expanding durable external contracts requires maintainer intent and explicit upgrade semantics.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve existing public cron status compatibility while representing yielded-parent handoff in internal lifecycle and task state.

options.title: Publish deferred
options.body: Adopt `deferred` as a supported external status and require fresh-install, upgrade, client, plugin, and operator proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public cron status compatibility while representing yielded-parent handoff in internal lifecycle and task state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the adjacent Discord status flow, cron result handling, and subagent lifecycle surfaces involved in this product choice.
